centerEstimation: Centers were estimated by visual grounding on the crop and cross-checked against an independent smoothness/brightness mask analysis of the same image; the two methods agreed within ~0.02 normalized units for every pocket.
coordinateSystem: normalized 0..1, origin top-left, x to the right, y downward (same convention as the app's markers)
description: PTP blister sheet (Meiji Porsuvi 5mg) with 10 tablets, 2 columns x 5 rows, photographed on a desk. Cropped from the user's iPhone screenshot of the CountLog app (the 17-count review screen); the crop rectangle in the 1206x2622 screenshot is x=348, y=366, width=810, height=1080. The crop still contains the app's red numbered marker overlays from that run - several sit on or near pockets, others are false hits on the foil print and the desk. Ground truth is the tablets themselves, not the markers.
exemplarNote: Tight box around the row 1 / column 1 tablet, used as the exemplar for exemplarMatch and as the area reference for blobCount.
